info.description: The CBSE Mandatory Public Disclosure at /general-info/. Replaces apps/web/src/data/disclosure.ts. ⚠ THIS IS A REGULATORY FILING, NOT MARKETING COPY. Every figure here is transcribed from the school's own documents and must continue to agree with the PDFs linked beside it — a value corrected here and not in the filing makes the page disagree with the document of record. ⚠ REFILED ANNUALLY: the board results, staff summary, teacher list, infrastructure figures and all thirteen certificates change each session, which is why they are editable rather than compiled in. ⚠ THE 131 TEACHERS ARE A SEPARATE COLLECTION (Teacher), not a component here — a 131-entry repeatable field is unusable in the admin, and the collection gives a searchable, filterable list. The designation filter on the page is DERIVED from it and is never a typed list.
